    label "alg:exchange"
    text "Exchange sort of an invented list."
  algorithm numbered
    line 0 io input
      text "a list "
      formula inline "L"
        ord:𝐿
      text " of "
      formula inline "n"
        ord:𝑛
      text " invented weights"
    line 0 io output
      text "the same list, lightest first"
    line 0 open for
      formula inline "i \\gets 1"
        ord:𝑖 rel:← ord:1
      text " "
      styled bold
        italicCorr maybe
        text "to"
      italicCorr maybe
      text " "
      formula inline "n"
        ord:𝑛
    line 1 statement
      comment
        text "one pass floats the heaviest weight to the end"
    line 1 open for
      formula inline "j \\gets 1"
        ord:𝑗 rel:← ord:1
      text " "
      styled bold
        italicCorr maybe
        text "to"
      italicCorr maybe
      text " "
      formula inline "n - i"
        ord:𝑛 bin:− ord:𝑖
    line 2 open if
      formula inline "L_j > L_{j+1}"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗} rel:> ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗 bin:+ ord:1}
    line 3 statement
      text "swap "
      formula inline "L_j"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗}
      text " and "
      formula inline "L_{j+1}"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗 bin:+ ord:1}
    line 2 open else
    line 3 statement
      text "keep the pair as it stands"
    line 2 close else
    line 1 close for
    line 0 close for
    line 0 return
      formula inline "L"
        ord:𝐿

  text "Algorithm "

float algorithm 2 caption-above
  caption
    text "The same exchange sort, algorithmicx spelling."
  algorithm numbered
    line 0 io input
      text "a list "
      formula inline "L"
        ord:𝐿
      text " of "
      formula inline "n"
        ord:𝑛
      text " invented weights"
    line 0 io output
      text "the same list, lightest first"
    line 0 open for
      formula inline "i = 1, \\dots , n"
        ord:𝑖 rel:= ord:1 punct:, inner:… punct:, ord:𝑛
    line 1 open for
      formula inline "j = 1, \\dots , n - i"
        ord:𝑗 rel:= ord:1 punct:, inner:… punct:, ord:𝑛 bin:− ord:𝑖
    line 2 open if
      formula inline "L_j > L_{j+1}"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗} rel:> ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗 bin:+ ord:1}
    line 3 statement
      text "swap "
      formula inline "L_j"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗}
      text " and "
      formula inline "L_{j+1}"
        ord:𝐿_{ord:𝑗 bin:+ ord:1}
      comment
        text "exchange the pair"
    line 2 close if
    line 1 close for
    line 0 close for
    line 0 return
      formula inline "L"
        ord:𝐿
